name: US: toll-free caller IDs
description: Gives a low-score warning for calls that show a toll-free number (800, 833, 844, 855, 866, 877, 888). Robocallers often spoof these, and real businesses rarely call from them.
author: Parley

sources.title: FCC: What is a toll-free number and how does it work? (codes 800, 888, 877, 866, 855, 844, 833)

notes: Android doesn't let Parley combine this with the network's caller verification result, so it warns on every toll-free caller ID. To use verification, turn on "Stop calls that fail verification" in Blocking.
